The '''Colundra sector''' was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] located at the end of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> Planets in Colundra included [[Kashoon]], [[Kruskan]], [[Muskree]], [[Qotile/Legends|Qotile]], [[Sonn Vilmari]], and [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]]. During [[Operation Shadow Hand]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] got wind of a "promising deal" in the sector.
